model.title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of September as "Dystonia Awareness Month" to promote public awareness and understanding of dystonia.

summary.text: The resolution expresses support for designating September as "Dystonia Awareness Month" to help raise public awareness and understanding of dystonia, a neurological movement disorder.
